title: General Insulation Company
content:
General Insulation Company is a large B2B insulation distributor with a broad branch footprint across the United States. It supplies aerogel insulation materials for mechanical, commercial, and industrial applications and also provides fabrication support.

  • Coverage Area: United States
  • Focus Areas: Mechanical insulation, commercial construction insulation, industrial pipe systems, cryogenic insulation, and aerogel blanket fabrication
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel® XTE, Cryogel® Z) and Armacell (ArmaGel® HT, ArmaGel® DT)
  • Official Website: https://www.generalinsulation.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
